status: draft, awaiting the owner's sign-off in the BL-025 Log; nothing runs before it
name: BL-025 drawdown-rule test: candidate rules, what they are applied to, and the pass / kill rule
source: backlog/BL-025-live-money-rules.md, ## Experiments, block '2026-10-28 - Drawdown rules with a way back in'; this file is the machine-readable copy of its numbers
rule: Committed before any run. Holds registered numbers only, never a result. Never edited after a run: a change is a new file (bl025_rules_criteria_addendum_N.json) that names this one as superseded, with the reason.

followed.name: Four Sectors Monthly, No Tilt · all Fridays (run fbb7ab054238, four sleeves, offsets 0 to 3)
followed.ranking: post-F6 (BL-001 F6 fix, merge commit 778ba02e) only
followed.engine: tracker.run_config with bias.Runner(search_spaces/round7_A.toml, universe_kind turnover_rank, category_tags curated), as live_rules.paper_curves; pre-tax, itemised costs, signal delay 1, Rs 2 lakh

window.to: the last Friday in the data when the run starts (recorded with the result)

objects.sleeves: each of the four sleeves alone, from its first week
objects.blend: equal capital in the four sleeves, reset to equal at the last week before each 1 April (choose.ensemble_curve)

lot_ramp.what: the object the weekly check reads: four lots put in from cash one Friday after another, each the sleeve that trades that Friday, measured as live_rules.twr_index; the rules read the high since the ramp's first Friday
lot_ramp.first_friday_rule: the first Friday of each January and July, 2017 to 2025, as live_rules.lot_starts resolves it; each ramp runs to the end of the data

mechanics.trigger_curve: the model curve of the object (full size, never the money held), as the weekly check measures it
mechanics.decision: Friday close; the new size applies from the next week's return (decision Friday to the following Friday)
mechanics.cash: the weekly table's 'Cash (liquid fund)' series (engine.CASH) for the share not invested
mechanics.high: the highest weekly close of the model curve since the object's first week, or since the last return to full size, whichever is later
mechanics.one_week_both_lines: a week that crosses both lines goes straight to 0
mechanics.while_half: the exit line is still measured from the same high
mechanics.trades: a size change sells or buys the change in size across every holding, pro rata; the engine's own weekly trades are unchanged inside the curve

R1_as_written.role: live_rules.toml today, read literally: the logged review that may allow re-entry has no backtestable form, so it is never

R2_back_at_the_high.back_to_full: the first Friday the model curve closes at or above the high it was measured from
R2_back_at_the_high.re_entry: same condition, straight to full size
R2_back_at_the_high.role: today's lines completed with the one point the weekly check already treats as the all-clear

R3_trend_back.back_to_full: the first Friday the model curve closes above its 40-week simple moving average, after it has closed below that average on some Friday since the action
R3_trend_back.re_entry: same condition, straight to full size
R3_trend_back.role: the 10-month moving-average trend rule (about 40 weekly closes), fixed at its conventional length

R4_rebound_back.back_to_full: the first Friday the model curve closes at least 20% above its lowest weekly close since the action
R4_rebound_back.re_entry: same condition, straight to full size
R4_rebound_back.role: back in after a rise as large as the fall that triggered the cut

R5_owner_band_trend_back.role: the lines at the ends of the owner's stated tolerance (BL-010: 25-35%, hard ceiling 40%), with R3's way back

N_alert_and_review.role: the non-mechanical option: the alert fires at the lines and the owner decides each time; listed so the verdict can choose it, never scored

replaces_current_rules_only_if_all.on: each of the four sleeves, the blend, and every registered lot ramp
replaces_current_rules_only_if_all.cagr_give_up_on: the blend, and the median over the registered lot ramps

pass.x_reason: 3 points of CAGR a year is the gap BL-010's criteria already treat as the smallest meaningful difference (phase_4 offset_average, phase_5 walk_forward, holdings advice): an overlay that costs less is within the project's accepted noise
pass.several_pass: the highest blend end wealth; candidates within 1 CAGR point of it are ordered R2, R4, R3, R5 (fewest conditions first) and the first is named
pass.none_pass: the current lines stay; the verdict says so and the owner chooses between R1 and N_alert_and_review as the re-entry text
pass.kill: a candidate that fails any condition above is killed for this strategy
pass.r0: R0 is the comparator and is judged by worst_fall_of_money_held_max like the others; if it passes that alone, the verdict reports 'dropping the lines is consistent with your limits' for the owner to weigh
pass.verdict_wording: with about three independent falls of 20% or more in the sample, a pass reads 'consistent with', never 'proven' or 'shown'

reported_not_judged: end wealth and CAGR of money held, after costs, per object
worst fall of money held, and its date
weeks at half size and at zero, and their share of all weeks
cuts not followed by an exit in the same fall
exits within 8 weeks before the fall's lowest weekly close, and the weeks from each exit or cut to that low
weeks from the low to each return to full size, and the model curve's rise over those weeks
number of size changes, their costs in rupees at Rs 2 lakh, and the tax of each sale (estimated)
each candidate's CAGR give-up per fall (which fall decides the result)
the same rules with every action one week later (the owner acts a week late); one fixed delay, not a grid
the total number of candidates scored (6), stated with the verdict

costs_and_tax.costs: the engine's itemised rates (round7_A.toml cost_model itemised) on the value each size change sells and buys
costs_and_tax.tax: estimated from each sleeve's open tax lots on the decision Friday (its trade log, tax.py's rules: STCG 20%, LTCG 12.5% plus cess) on the share sold; reported only, because the strategy's monthly rotation already realises almost every gain short-term, so the overlay moves tax in time more than in amount

look_ahead.rule: every decision on Friday t uses the model curve up to and including t only: the high as a running maximum, the moving average of closes t-39..t, the low since the action up to t
look_ahead.check_1: for every Friday t of every object, the size path computed from the curve cut at t equals the full run's path up to t; any difference kills the run
look_ahead.check_2: a unit test: a synthetic curve whose weeks after t are replaced gives the same actions up to t
look_ahead.check_3: the size decided at t multiplies the return t to t+1, never the return ending at t (asserted in the code)
look_ahead.known_bias: the curves themselves use today's curated category tags (BL-010 F3, survivorship through tagging): they may understate the falls; both sides of every comparison share it

hold_out.forward: the weeks after 2026-10-16 (stage.paper_start): the only unseen data, too short to judge; reported each time the result is refreshed
hold_out.possible_later: 2012-04 to 2016-12 for the same four sleeves (stock bars, factors and the point-in-time universe exist from 2011; BL-010 addendum 5's patches). BL-010 left that window spent and unread, and BL-176 may want it for the re-selection; reading it here needs the owner's 'override: <reason>' and only after BL-176 decides. If read: one run, the R0 and the named candidate only, judged on worst fall of money held of the blend <= 0.35; the CAGR give-up reported, not judged

will_not_run: any grid or sweep of the lines, the moving-average length, the rebound, X or the delay
any candidate not listed here, or a listed one with a changed number
any figure on the pre-F6 ranking, except as labelled context
volatility targeting, single-name stops (BL-084), or a change of strategy (BL-176)
the 2012-2016 window, without the owner's override
override: running anything under will_not_run needs 'override: <reason>' from the owner in the BL-025 Log first
